paper: Nova3D arXiv:2607.22738v1, Section 4.1 and Section 8, Tables 11-12

required_inputs.prompt_manifest: Original text/image-conditioned prompts; constraints must be prompt-stated.
required_inputs.frozen_specs: One machine-checkable spec.yaml per constrained item, frozen before output scoring.
required_inputs.final_glbs: Final exported GLB artifacts scored without trusting source self-reports.
required_inputs.measure_recipes: Semantic scene-node anchors plus exact-count or geometry-dimension recipes, comparator and tolerance.

scoring.count_pass: passed exact-count constraints / all exact-count constraints

anti_leakage: Do not infer targets or tolerances from generated URDF/GLB geometry.
Do not use template source constants as a substitute for prompt-stated benchmark constraints.
Do not score compile/QC, joint metadata or motion-QC as paper numeric/count constraints.
Do not compare a locally invented constraint set directly with the paper's 52-constraint set.
